async function craftEightJunglePlanks(bot) {
    // This function ensures the bot has at least eight jungle planks. It first checks the current inventory count of jungle planks. If fewer than eight are present, it calculates how many more are needed. It then checks if enough jungle logs are available to cover the required crafting steps. If logs are insufficient, it mines the necessary amount of jungle logs. Finally, it crafts the required number of jungle planks using the available logs.
}
